in_sanskrit.name: महीपत्सिंह
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has the power over all the gods and the universe. The king of all beings. (मही - Mahī, meaning 'earth' or 'universe'; पति - Patī, meaning 'lord' or 'master'; सिंह - Siṃha, meaning 'lion')

in_hindi.name: महिपत्सिंह
in_hindi.long_meaning: The supreme lord. (महीपती - Mahipatī, meaning 'supreme lord')

in_tamil.name: மகிபத்சிங்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who has the power over all beings and the universe. (மகி - Makī, meaning 'all'; பத்சி - Patsi, meaning 'power'; ங் - ṅ, a consonant used as a suffix to denote masculine gender)

in_telugu.name: మహిపత్సింహ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The primary ruler. (మహి - Mahi, meaning 'great'; పత్ - Pat, meaning 'lord'; సింహ - Siṃha, meaning 'lion')

in_marathi.name: Mahipatsinh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Battlefield
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahipatsinh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahipatsinh is a compound name derived from Mahipat and Sinh. Mahipat means 'Lord' or 'God' and Sinh means 'Lion'. Thus, Mahipatsinh can be interpreted as 'Lord of the Battlefield' or 'God of the Lions'. This name is often given to a son in the hope that he will be brave, strong, and victorious like a lion.
